observed_by: Codex orchestrator through the actual local browser; delegated local ASR execution and independent code review

automated_checks.note: These checks include targeted tool transport regressions and existing application tests. They do not complete the revised S01 acceptance contract.

tool_probe.target: One fixed synthetic fixture; no care database or command access
tool_probe.verification: Exact namespace/function/arguments validation precedes one fixture read; second completed assistant message reproduces the newly generated fixture value
earlier_attempts: First attempt stopped before local dispatch because the helper discarded finalized streamed items when terminal output was empty.

A subsequent diagnostic attempt returned an unclassified provider stream failure (HTTP 0 in the helper). Its raw body and complete usage were not captured; no cause or complete all-attempt total is claimed.
A diagnostic completed first turn recorded empty terminal output and 86 input/25 output tokens. The adapter was repaired to collect response.output_item.done items before stateless continuation.
tool_probe.automated_boundaries: Unknown namespace/function/target/fields, duplicate/missing/incomplete calls, invented or unfinished output and quota refusal fail closed; no retries or billed/model fallback
tool_probe.limits: At most two Responses requests per tool probe, 45-second local timeout and 1 MB stream cap per request. max_output_tokens is unsupported in this preview; local limits are not hard remote usage caps.

local_speech_recognition.compatibility_finding: PyAV 19.0.1 rejected the metadata_errors keyword used by faster-whisper 1.2.1. Verified PyAV 18.1.0 is pinned; the final cached CPU run passed.

limitations: Only the owner's local account connection and synthetic tool transport are proven. No shared entitlement, production route, care-command authorization or full credential lifecycle qualification is asserted.
Synthetic-file speech generation/recognition does not establish audible playback, a microphone conversation, target-device usability or interruption behavior.
